admin.settings.page.general.description: Link to the page of the server settings with the server's name, descriptions, contact and thumbnail.

admin.settings.page.branding.description: Link to the page of the server settings with the server's icon and logos.

admin.settings.page.registration.description: Link to the page of the server settings with who may sign up, the members' invites and the registration of apps.

admin.settings.page.content.description: Link to the page of the server settings with the default language, the public timelines, the posts, the landing page and the featured accounts.

admin.settings.page.federation.description: Link to the page of the server settings with the federation, the list of domain actions and the external review.

admin.settings.page.discovery.description: Link to the page of the server settings with what the server states to search engines and AI, and the post search.

admin.settings.page.voice.description: Link to the page of the server settings with the voice chat settings.

admin.settings.general.save.description: Button that saves the name, the descriptions, the contact and the thumbnail of the server together.

admin.settings.general.saved.defaultMessage: Guardado. El registro de auditoría anota el cambio.
admin.settings.general.saved.description: Result beside the save button of the general page of the server settings after a save.

admin.settings.general.unchanged.defaultMessage: Todo en esta página ya está guardado.
admin.settings.general.unchanged.description: Result beside the save button of the general page of the server settings when nothing changed.

admin.settings.general.save_failed.description: Result beside the save button of the general page of the server settings when the save failed; the reason follows.

admin.settings.voice.unavailable.defaultMessage: Este servidor no ofrece chat de voz, así que aquí no hay nada que configurar.
admin.settings.voice.unavailable.description: Text of the voice chat page of the server settings while the server does not offer voice chat.

admin.settings.page.auto_delete.description: Link to the page of the server settings with the default and the maximum of the automatic deletion of old posts.

admin.settings.auto_delete.number.invali.defaultMessage: Escribe un número entero de {min} a {max}.
admin.settings.auto_delete.number.invali.description: Error under a number field of the automatic deletion settings when its value is not a whole number in range.

admin.settings.auto_delete.default.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's default policy of the automatic deletion of old posts.

admin.settings.auto_delete.default.descr.defaultMessage: Cada cuenta nueva empieza con esta configuración como propia y puede cambiarla. Cambiarla no modifica las cuentas existentes.
admin.settings.auto_delete.default.descr.description: Help of the section of the server's default policy of the automatic deletion: it is copied at sign-up.

admin.settings.auto_delete.default.enabl.description: Checkbox of the server's default: new accounts start with the automatic deletion turned on.

admin.settings.auto_delete.default.age.description: Label of the number field of the default age in days after which posts are deleted.

admin.settings.auto_delete.days.descript.defaultMessage: Contados desde que se publicó cada publicación: de {min} a {max} días.
admin.settings.auto_delete.days.descript.description: Help of the default age of the automatic deletion. {min} and {max} are the bounds.

admin.settings.auto_delete.default.keep.description: Label of the group of the exceptions of the server's default policy.

admin.settings.auto_delete.default.visib.description: Label of the group of the visibilities that the server's default policy keeps.

admin.settings.auto_delete.default.min_b.description: Label of the number field of the default threshold of boosts that keeps a post.

admin.settings.auto_delete.default.min_f.defaultMessage: Conservar publicaciones marcadas como favoritas al menos (veces)
admin.settings.auto_delete.default.min_f.description: Label of the number field of the default threshold of favourites that keeps a post.

admin.settings.auto_delete.threshold.des.defaultMessage: 0 no conserva ninguna publicación por esto. De {min} a {max}.
admin.settings.auto_delete.threshold.des.description: Help of a threshold of the server's default policy. {min} and {max} are the bounds.

admin.settings.auto_delete.pinned.description: Exception of the automatic deletion in the server settings: posts pinned to the profile.

admin.settings.auto_delete.bookmarked.defaultMessage: Guardadas como marcador por el autor
admin.settings.auto_delete.bookmarked.description: Exception of the automatic deletion in the server settings: posts the author bookmarked.

admin.settings.auto_delete.favourited.defaultMessage: Marcadas como favoritas por el autor
admin.settings.auto_delete.favourited.description: Exception of the automatic deletion in the server settings: posts the author favourited.

admin.settings.auto_delete.media.defaultMessage: Con imágenes u otro contenido multimedia
admin.settings.auto_delete.media.description: Exception of the automatic deletion in the server settings: posts with media attachments.

admin.settings.auto_delete.polls.description: Exception of the automatic deletion in the server settings: posts with a poll.

admin.settings.auto_delete.max.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's maximum of how long local posts are kept.

admin.settings.auto_delete.max.descripti.defaultMessage: Mientras el máximo esté activado, todas las cuentas locales eliminan sus publicaciones como mucho esta cantidad de días después de publicarlas, y no pueden desactivar la eliminación automática. Las cuentas con roles que tienen el permiso para conservar publicaciones más tiempo quedan exentas. La página de información muestra el máximo.
admin.settings.auto_delete.max.descripti.description: Help of the section of the server's maximum of the automatic deletion.

admin.settings.auto_delete.max.age.description: Label of the number field of the server's maximum in days.

admin.settings.auto_delete.max.age.descr.defaultMessage: 0 no establece ningún máximo. Hasta {max} días.
admin.settings.auto_delete.max.age.descr.description: Help of the maximum's days. {max} is the upper bound; {min} is 0 and not shown.

admin.settings.auto_delete.max.allow.description: Label of the group of the exceptions that the maximum lets accounts keep posts by.

admin.settings.auto_delete.max.allow.des.defaultMessage: Una excepción marcada puede conservar una publicación más allá del máximo, mientras se aplique.
admin.settings.auto_delete.max.allow.des.description: Help of the group of the exceptions allowed under the maximum.

admin.settings.auto_delete.max.allow.vis.description: Allowance of the maximum: posts may be kept by their visibility.

admin.settings.auto_delete.max.allow.thr.defaultMessage: Conservar publicaciones con muchos impulsos o favoritos
admin.settings.auto_delete.max.allow.thr.description: Allowance of the maximum: posts may be kept by their numbers of boosts and favourites.

admin.settings.auto_delete.max.kept_pins.defaultMessage: Publicaciones fijadas conservadas bajo el máximo
admin.settings.auto_delete.max.kept_pins.description: Label of the number field of how many of an account's pins keep posts under the maximum.

admin.settings.auto_delete.max.kept_pins.defaultMessage: Las fijadas más recientemente primero: de {min} a {max}. {max} conserva todas las publicaciones fijadas.
admin.settings.auto_delete.max.kept_pins.description: Help of the number of pins kept under the maximum. {min} and {max} are the bounds; {max} is the most pins of an account.

admin.settings.auto_delete.grace.description: Label of the number field of the grace period of an account newly bound by the maximum.

admin.settings.auto_delete.grace.descrip.defaultMessage: Cuánto tiempo conserva su propia configuración una cuenta a la que el máximo se aplica por primera vez, después de ser avisada: de {min} a {max} días. Cambiarlo no mueve las fechas ya comunicadas.
admin.settings.auto_delete.grace.descrip.description: Help of the grace period of the maximum. {min} and {max} are the bounds.

admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.title.defaultMessage: ¿Conservar las publicaciones como máximo {days, plural, one {# día} other {# días}}?
admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.title.description: Title of the dialog that asks before turning the maximum of the automatic deletion on. {days} is the maximum.

admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.title.defaultMessage: ¿Endurecer el máximo, a {days, plural, one {# día} other {# días}}?
admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.title.description: Title of the dialog that asks before lowering the maximum or allowing fewer exceptions or pins. {days} is the maximum.

admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.notif.defaultMessage: En una hora, se notificará, en la aplicación y por correo electrónico, a todas las cuentas locales cuya configuración conserve las publicaciones más tiempo.
admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.notif.description: In the dialog before turning on or tightening the maximum: who is notified and how.

admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.grace.defaultMessage: {days, plural, =0 {Sus publicaciones empiezan a eliminarse según el máximo de inmediato.} one {Sus publicaciones empiezan a eliminarse según el máximo # día después del aviso.} other {Sus publicaciones empiezan a eliminarse según el máximo # días después del aviso.}}
admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.grace.description: In the dialog before turning on or tightening the maximum: when the posts of the notified accounts start to go. {days} is the grace period.

admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.perma.defaultMessage: Las publicaciones eliminadas no se pueden restaurar, ni aquí ni en los servidores a los que se enviaron.
admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.perma.description: In the dialog before turning on or tightening the maximum: deletions are permanent.

admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.exemp.defaultMessage: Las cuentas con el permiso para conservar publicaciones más tiempo no se ven afectadas. Una cuenta que cambie su configuración a un valor dentro del máximo antes de entonces conserva su propia configuración.
admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.exemp.description: Note in the dialog before turning on or tightening the maximum.

admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.cance.description: Button that closes the dialog without saving the maximum.

admin.settings.auto_delete.confirm.confi.description: Button that saves the stricter maximum, which notifies the bound accounts.
